name: punch-lunge-collision-filter
description: Verify real server lunges ignore a queryable production pickup while retaining physical-solid clearance, measured motion, and server ownership.

args.code:
local function verifyLungeFixtureRow(row)
 assert(row.accepted and row.timestampFresh and row.ownershipAdvanced,'actual new server punch required')
 assert(row.serverOwned and row.physicsSamples>=2 and row.maxObservedMove>1 and row.unanchored,'actual physical server-owned lunge required')
 assert(row.noDepthTarget and row.planClear and row.requested==10.5 and row.planned==10.5,'fixture must isolate the ordinary physical-solid ray')
 assert(math.abs(row.actualMoved-row.expectedTravel)<.15 and math.abs(row.reportedTravel-row.expectedTravel)<.02,'actual root movement and server travel must match the native physical ray')
 assert(row.bodyOverlaps==0 and row.endpointClearance>=2.45,'lunge must stop before solid geometry')
 assert(row.coinsUnchanged and row.petsUnchanged,'fixture must not grant economy or pets')
 if row.case=='clear' then assert(row.originalNoHit and row.physicalNoHit and row.expectedTravel==10.5,'clear path must preserve full lunge')
 elseif row.case=='egg' then assert(row.originalHitEgg and row.eggQueryable and row.eggNoncollidable and row.physicalNoHit and row.expectedTravel==10.5,'query-only production egg must remain pickable without shortening lunge')
 elseif row.case=='solid' then assert(row.originalHitEgg and row.eggQueryable and row.eggNoncollidable and row.physicalHitSolid and row.expectedTravel>1 and row.expectedTravel<10.5,'solid collider behind egg must still stop lunge')
 else error('unknown lunge fixture case') end
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local R=game:GetService('RunService') local S=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() local world=workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG')
assert(R:IsStudio() and #players==1 and world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false and S:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'strict isolated ephemeral Studio required')
local p=players[1]
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'ready nonwritable ephemeral player required')
local c=S.PunchWallAutomation local fixtureName='SmashLungeCollisionQA'
assert(not workspace:FindFirstChild(fixtureName),'previous collision fixture must be cleaned')
local fixture=Instance.new('Folder') fixture.Name=fixtureName fixture:SetAttribute('OwnedByFlow','punch-lunge-collision-filter') fixture.Parent=workspace
local floor=Instance.new('Part') floor.Name='Isolated Floor' floor.Size=Vector3.new(60,1,80) floor.CFrame=CFrame.new(-2,100,10) floor.Anchored=true floor.CanCollide=true floor.Parent=fixture
local connection local rows={}
local function cleanup()
 if connection then connection:Disconnect() connection=nil end
 local resetOK,reset=pcall(function()return c:Invoke('Reset')end)
 if fixture and fixture.Parent then fixture:Destroy()end
 return resetOK and type(reset)=='table' and reset.ok==true and workspace:FindFirstChild(fixtureName)==nil
end
local ok,why=xpcall(function()
 for _,caseName in ipairs({'clear','egg','solid'})do
  assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'case reset failed')
  assert(c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15,WallLevel=99,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}).ok==true,'case stats failed')
  local character=p.Character local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  assert(root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not root.Anchored,'living unanchored character required')
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,104,26),Vector3.new(-2,104,0))
  local deadline=os.clock()+2 local stable=0
  repeat task.wait(.05) if math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)<.1 and root.Position.Y>102 and root.Position.Y<105 and math.abs((character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier')or 0)-1)<=.003 then stable+=1 else stable=0 end until stable>=3 or os.clock()>=deadline
  assert(stable>=3 and p.Character==character,'fixture body did not settle on its isolated floor')
  local start=root.Position local direction=Vector3.new(0,0,-1) local egg local eggModel local solid
  if caseName~='clear' then
   assert(c:Invoke('ForcePetEggDrop',1).ok==true,'production egg spawn failed')
   local folder=world.Interactables['Pet Egg Drops'] eggModel=folder:FindFirstChild('Mystery Pet Egg '..p.UserId) egg=eggModel and eggModel.PrimaryPart
   assert(egg and eggModel:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='PetDropEgg' and eggModel:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId')==p.UserId and eggModel:GetAttribute('DropId')==p:GetAttribute('ActivePetEggDropId'),'actual owned production egg required')
   assert(egg.CanQuery and not egg.CanCollide and egg:FindFirstChild('Pet Egg Click Pickup'),'pickup properties must stay unchanged')
   eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(start+direction*5))
  end
  if caseName=='solid' then
   solid=Instance.new('Part') solid.Name='Physical Stop' solid.Size=Vector3.new(20,20,1) solid.CFrame=CFrame.new(start+direction*8) solid.Anchored=true solid.CanCollide=true solid.CanQuery=true solid.Parent=fixture
  end
  local function cast(respect)
   local params=RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,world['Depth Physics Debris'],world['Depth Blocks']} params.IgnoreWater=true params.RespectCanCollide=respect
   return workspace:Raycast(start,direction*10.5,params)
  end
  local originalRay=cast(false) local physicalRay=cast(true)
  local expectedTravel=physicalRay and math.max(0,physicalRay.Distance-2.6)or 10.5
  assert(caseName=='solid' and physicalRay and physicalRay.Instance==solid or caseName~='solid' and physicalRay==nil,'unexpected fixture ray blocker')
  if egg then assert(originalRay and originalRay.Instance==egg,'query-only egg must intercept the original native ray')else assert(originalRay==nil,'clear native ray required')end
  local beforeTime=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() local beforeToken=p:GetAttribute('PunchOwnershipToken')or 0
  local beforeCoins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value local beforePets=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value
  local samples=0 local serverOwned=true local maxObservedMove=0 local unanchored=true local observerError
  connection=R.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
   local readOK,readError=pcall(function()
    samples+=1 assert(samples<=240,'physics observation cap exceeded')
    serverOwned=serverOwned and root:GetNetworkOwner()==nil unanchored=unanchored and not root.Anchored
    maxObservedMove=math.max(maxObservedMove,(root.Position-start):Dot(direction))
   end)
   if not readOK then observerError=tostring(readError)end
  end)
  local punch=c:Invoke('PunchRadius')
  connection:Disconnect() connection=nil
  assert(not observerError,'physics observer failed: '..tostring(observerError))
  local actualMoved=(root.Position-start):Dot(direction)
  local overlaps=0 local clearance=999
  if solid then
   local cf,size=character:GetBoundingBox() local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={solid}
   overlaps=#workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,size,overlap)
   clearance=(solid.Position-root.Position):Dot(direction)-solid.Size.Z*.5
  end
  local row={case=caseName,accepted=type(punch)=='table' and punch.outcome=='no_block',timestampFresh=(p:GetAttribute('LastPunchLungeAt')or 0)>=beforeTime,ownershipAdvanced=p:GetAttribute('PunchOwnershipToken')==beforeToken+1,
   physicsSamples=samples,serverOwned=serverOwned,unanchored=unanchored,maxObservedMove=maxObservedMove,requested=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchRequestedDistance'),planned=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchPlannedLungeDistance'),planClear=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchPlanningBarrier')=='none',noDepthTarget=p:GetAttribute('LastRadiusHitCount')==0,
   actualMoved=actualMoved,reportedTravel=p:GetAttribute('LastPunchLungeDistance'),expectedTravel=expectedTravel,bodyOverlaps=overlaps,endpointClearance=clearance,
   originalNoHit=originalRay==nil,physicalNoHit=physicalRay==nil,originalHitEgg=egg~=nil and originalRay~=nil and originalRay.Instance==egg,physicalHitSolid=solid~=nil and physicalRay~=nil and physicalRay.Instance==solid,
   eggQueryable=egg~=nil and egg.CanQuery,eggNoncollidable=egg~=nil and not egg.CanCollide,coinsUnchanged=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value==beforeCoins,petsUnchanged=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value==beforePets}
  table.insert(rows,row) verifyLungeFixtureRow(row)
  if solid then solid:Destroy()end
 end
end,debug.traceback)
local cleaned=cleanup()
local result={lungeCollisionContractValid=ok and cleaned and #rows==3,cleaned=cleaned,rows=rows,error=not ok and string.sub(tostring(why),1,700)or nil}
local encoded=H:JSONEncode(result) assert(#encoded<3900,'lunge collision evidence exceeds bound')return encoded
